name: katala-tune
description: Katala フリート（Mac / Windows）を並列に分析し、承認した最適化だけを実行するデスクトップアプリ

scripts.electron:package: electron-packager . 'Katala Tune' --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --ignore='^/(dist|test|docs|scripts|src-tauri|crates|\.claude|\.github|build/icon\.iconset)' --app-bundle-id=org.katala.tune && node scripts/harden.js 'dist/Katala Tune-darwin-arm64/Katala Tune.app'
scripts.electron:package:win: electron-packager . 'Katala Tune' --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=build/icon.ico --ignore='^/(dist|test|docs|scripts|src-tauri|crates|\.claude|\.github|build/icon\.iconset)' && node scripts/harden.js 'dist/Katala Tune-win32-x64/Katala Tune.exe' && cd dist && rm -f Katala-Tune-win-x64.zip && zip -qry Katala-Tune-win-x64.zip 'Katala Tune-win32-x64'
